title: HelixDB: a graph-vector database for knowledge graphs and AI memory
description:
Building an AI app today means duct-taping three databases together: Postgres for your data, Pinecone for vectors, and a graph DB for relationships, then babysitting all three. HelixDB collapses that into one. It's an open-source, OLTP graph-vector database built from scratch in Rust, with graph traversal, vector search, and its own strongly-typed query language, HelixQL, in a single engine. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/HelixDB/helix-db/tree/main
